title: ITR Filing Deadline for AY 2026-27 (ITR-1 & ITR-2) Remains July 31 – No Extension Expected
content:
# ITR Filing Deadline for AY 2026-27 (ITR-1 & ITR-2) Remains July 31 – No Extension Expected

Ek important update hai. Government ne Assessment Year (AY) 2026-27 ke liye Income Tax Return (ITR-1 aur ITR-2) filing ki deadline extend karne ke liye koi announcement nahi kiya hai, aur filhaal July 31, 2026 hi due date hai.

As of July 28, 2026, multiple sources confirm that the standard statutory deadline of July 31, 2026, for filing ITR-1 and ITR-2 by individuals and Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs) who are not subject to a tax audit, remains unchanged. Taxpayers ko kisi extension ka wait kiye bina, time par apna ITR file karne ki salaah di ja rahi hai.

*   **Applicable Assessment Year:** AY 2026-27 (Financial Year 2025-26).
*   **Forms Covered:** ITR-1 (Sahaj) and ITR-2.
*   **Due Date for Non-Audit Cases:** July 31, 2026.
*   **Extension Status:** No official notification for an extension has been issued by the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) as of July 28, 2026. The ITR forms for AY 2026-27 are already live and enabled on the e-filing portal.

Taxpayers should prioritize timely filing to avoid late fees, interest charges, and other complications.
